result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to develop and launch a specialized handoff tracking product targeting small software teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Assessment of workflow friction and handoff overhead among small software engineering teams in Latvia.
- Evaluation of tool integration requirements and willingness to adopt dedicated handoff tooling.
- Exclusion of payroll, compensation, or financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Leads software delivery teams, oversees task transition processes, and evaluates productivity tooling.

- How much team time is spent each week compiling and transferring status updates between team members? (question-f3db9c399d0380c0a5d220ae)
- Which tools currently support your handoff workflows, and what gaps remain unaddressed? (question-2c6149e6e96ea0d7ed3514f7)
- What budget authority and criteria would apply for adopting a dedicated workflow tracking utility? (question-46b61322e6cd77fd4eba5e0b)

## Software Developer

Prepares technical updates and receives in-flight work and tasks during project handoffs.

- What critical context or detail is most frequently missing when receiving a task handed off by a colleague? (question-86bfc6db91a26723eb91a4d5)
- How does the manual copying of updates impact your focused engineering time during end-of-week handoffs? (question-fa83537b6c12e70f7f17ba6f)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software teams in Latvia experience recurring friction during task transitions across shifts or sprint cycles.
- Teams are willing to supplement existing issue trackers with a focused handoff tool.

## Evidence gaps

- Quantitative data regarding typical team sizes and software tooling expenditure among Latvian tech startups.
- Verified evidence on whether handoff friction directly causes project delivery delays in this market.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
